name: quioteframework/replay
description: Record → replay → regression test: a cassette format/store, a request recorder middleware, cassette:list/cassette:show console commands, and an effect ledger with per-subsystem recording/stub seams (database, HTTP client, cache, queue, env) for Quiote.

suggest.quioteframework/replay-propulsion: Records Propulsion queries into the effect ledger, via Propulsion's own query observer seam.
suggest.quioteframework/replay-doctrine: Records Doctrine DBAL queries into the effect ledger, via a DBAL driver middleware.
suggest.quioteframework/replay-eloquent: Records Eloquent (illuminate/database) queries into the effect ledger, via the QueryExecuted event.
suggest.quioteframework/replay-cycle: Records Cycle (cycle/database) queries into the effect ledger, via Cycle's own PSR-3 logger seam.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/replay/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
